errors.error_description: Declared an escaped identifier named \always_comb to use a reserved keyword as a signal name, which compiles but violates reserved-word usage guidelines.
Introduced a deeply nested chain of if-else statements for decoding, creating long combinational paths and poor synthesis quality.
Used an explicit sensitivity list that omits signals read within the block (en and dec_raw), causing a sensitivity list mismatch.
Used an always @(clk) level-sensitive block to update a state signal, mixing sequential intent without a proper clock edge.
